title: Farage tells BBC 'we live in a complainants' society' after questions over Reform funding
description: The Reform UK leader said a "whole ecosystem" didn't want "new kids on the block succeeding".

title: Four in court over murder of baby stabbed to death
description: Four people, aged between 19 and 38, appear in court charged with murdering the newborn.

title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
description: The Russian president wants to keep Britain guessing - and stressing - over Moscow's real intentions.

title: More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says
description: The ministry says the total number of people killed in the Strip since 10 October is now more than 1,300, including 301 children.

title: London mayor says conviction for untaxed car was due to a scam
description: City Hall officials say the Nissan Micra does not belong to the mayor or Transport for London.

title: UK aid worker says he was mistaken for survivor in Nepal
description: Alastair Chambers says the mix-up was after he returned to Kathmandu after flying back in an aid helicopter.

title: About 700 prisoners to be freed on 1 October under revised early release plans
description: The new plan shows Andy Burnham's government kept the promised original schedule of how and when offenders will leave jail.

title: Tiger Woods changes plea, gets five-year driving ban
description: The golfer will accept a five-year driving ban and $1,000 fine as part of a plea agreement.

title: King Charles, Macron and Burnham to preview Bayeux Tapestry display
description: British and French leaders will be at the British Museum to see the exhibition of the historic Bayeux Tapestry.
